purpose.evidence: README lines 1-6 states the player-facing purpose; AGENTS lines 1-28 and 30-40 set agent obligations; CONTRIBUTING links the canonical contribution standard.

structure.evidence: README is a short entry point with website links; CONTRIBUTING is a two-language pointer; AGENTS uses scoped working-rule headings, although one heading is corrupted (finding 3).

specificity.evidence: Follow-up d9e91c: AGENTS current full/ordinary policy replaces contradictory historical instructions; README names the native after-Start button and the tested Scouting/Crown exception.

reproducibility.evidence: README links the canonical installation and standalone-clone guides and gives git submodule update --init; .gitmodules and HEAD gitlinks match the listed xkit and Game API hashes. No claim is made that docs alone reproduce live acceptance.

evidence.evidence: README explicitly separates candidate internal 273/273 reference matches from approximate 175/213 mixed-battle matches. Prior accepted package/campaign receipt remains bounded; no new campaign freshness is claimed.

applicability.evidence: README identifies experimental status and player package versus source; AGENTS separates SDK development from normal independent DLL/H5U player launch. Canonical player article still labels preview.2 as the downloadable release and current candidate as unshipped; publication is pending, not evidence that preview.2 has current features.

translations.evidence: RU/EN policy and bounded metrics are parallel in README; AGENTS RU heading is readable and its RU/EN current-policy blocks agree.

maintenance.evidence: Canonical website remains the living manual and preview.2 remains the downloadable older release pending coordinated publication; source docs now distinguish candidate evidence and old release.
